profile.headline: AI Engineer | Computer Scientist | Ontology & Knowledge Graph Specialist
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. My core domain competency is in Finance (Fixed Income). At dv01 I was responsible for architecting and implementing a Securitization IDE and Document DB that enabled the rapid onboarding of Securitization/MBS deals onto the platform.

BSc in Computer Science and Software Engineering from State University of New York College at Oswego. Pursuing my MSc in CompSci.

Skilled in Microservices, GCP, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Scala, ZIO, Cats, Java, TypeScript, Concurrency, React, Compilers and Programming Language design, Domain Driven Design, Functional programming, Database Design, CSS and Fullstack Development, Graph DBs, Knowledge Graphs, Ontology, React.JS, Typescript, Asset Backed Finance, Fixed Income

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Cryptocurrency · Scala · Distributed Systems · Microservices · Software Infrastructure

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Document Management System: Fully architected, implemented and deployed a document-oriented database designed for storing, retrieving, and managing the life-cycle of document (json) oriented information. Improvements have included: json path search, bulk transformations and a system for rule-based validation. (Scala, Play, JsonSchema, mssql). The DMS has become a core part of our product infrastructure across all teams.

Securitization IDE (Integrated Development Environment): Designed (UI) and implemented a cloud based developer environment for modifying json configuration files. This editor is the front end for the Document Management system. Features include: a framework for adding extensions and plugins, enabling developers to create new widgets and embed those tools in the UI. Inline validation for analysts provided through inline IDE-like auto-completion, powered by JSON schema. [Typescript, React]

Formula Language Compiler: Created a formal language definition for an internal formula language, which is used in our Tape Cracker application. The AST is utilized in scala and TS for backend & front-end validation. On the front-end the parser is used to provide smart auto-completion (without making calls to the backend validator).

positions.title: Reactive Software Architect
positions.description:
Built a source-to-source compiler for internal rule language using Anltr4 and Scala. Generated target rule engine assembly code, backend for language server implementation, formalized language spec and grammar (G4). 

Rolled out an improved unit testing framework, eliminating the need for client facing team members to learn Scala to write their own test cases. Reduced the number of defects encountered at run time and improved developer productivity.

Rulang Web IDE: Designed and implemented a reactive scala/scala.js based rule language web IDE. Extended the ACE editor to support Antlr4 annotations, workspace artifact management, smart auto-completion, unit test execution and dependency analysis.

Pioneered use of Scala.js on the front-end to reduce the amount of code written to support the expanding rule language tooling ecosystem.

Provided tooling support and training for rule language writers and solutions team who had been tasked to work on client projects using the reactive rule language.

positions.title: Scala Software Engineer
positions.description:
Utilized Apache Camel and the AMPs messaging system to implement a reactive, message driven and stateless settlements and obligation processing engine.

Expanded the functionality and resilience of an internal reference database query library by integrating the Atmos retry library into the existing API.

Participated in all levels of the SDLC in order to port legacy systems into the new reactive message driven paradigm or replace them entirely.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
Created Azul, a React.JS web components library. Conformed to the standards defined in the IBM Cloud design language, support for dynamic graphs backed by d3.JS and elements borrowed from Google’s Material Design.

Dashboard 3.0: Engage directly with the client to design and develop impactful, dynamic, and insightful business intelligence visualizations, dashboards, and other analytic tools as part of the Dashboard 3.0 project.

NOTE: 3 month internship extension due to positive feedback and increased dependency on Azul.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
Java : Desktop actor-based (Akka) radar application development for the United States Marines.

Web Development; Javascript / HTML / CSS : Implemented new features and maintained the database back-end for the National Council on Aging’s senior assistance web portal.
